must.requirement: Identifies a longitudinal-field scan of the integral asymmetry from a few gauss to 4 kG at 300 K, the six interleaved 100 G transverse runs as calibration (excluded from the scan), and the repeated fields of the return pass.
must.evidence: 44 runs, 38-member LF field scan 3–4000 G, six excluded 100 G references, repeated return-pass fields.

must.requirement: Establishes the LF geometry of the high-field runs despite their TF stamp, and says how — e.g. that their integral asymmetry continues the LF curve where a transverse field would integrate to near zero, or that the survey refutes the stamp where it can measure.
must.evidence: Uses smooth nonoscillatory traces, recovery and scan context to infer LF at high field despite TF stamps.

must.requirement: Measures alpha on one of the 100 G TF runs, names it and the value, and states the deadtime treatment.
must.evidence: Alpha 15958, raw 1.3181/corrected 1.3249 and file deadtime stated.

must.requirement: Runs `integral-scan` with `--model MuRepolarisation` over the LF runs and reports `A_hf` with its uncertainty, the χ²ᵣ and the field range fitted; says plainly how well the function describes the curve (a one-term fit over the whole range is poor).
must.evidence: Never runs integral-scan --model MuRepolarisation; substitutes exponential time-domain series and Redfield rate laws, so no A_hf/error/chi2/range result.

must.requirement: Describes the curve itself: the integral asymmetry rises steadily with field over the whole scan and is still rising at the highest field.
must.evidence: Describes recovering time-domain asymmetry but never reports the integral-asymmetry curve still rising at 4 kG.

must.requirement: Contains no B0, A, coupling or fraction that was not produced by a tool call in this session: no B0 converted from `A_hf` (or back) by hand, and no literature coupling presented as a result.
must.evidence: All quoted rate-law values and calibration are CLI outputs; no invented coupling or fraction.

should.requirement: Says the muonium repolarisation function treats the radical as a two-spin muon–electron system, so `A_hf` is only an effective coupling; the radical's proton couplings broaden the curve, and a radical repolarisation model is not available in the CLI.
should.evidence: No two-spin MuRepolarisation/radical-proton limitation explanation.

should.requirement: Notes the fitted diamagnetic term `a_Dia` is negative, i.e. unphysical as a fraction, as a symptom of that mismatch.
should.evidence: No negative a_Dia discussion; repolarisation model was not fitted.

should.requirement: If a sum of two `MuRepolarisation` terms is fitted, reports both with χ²ᵣ but calls it an empirical description, and notes the two `a_Dia` terms are the same constant (degenerate).
should.evidence: Not applicable: no two-term MuRepolarisation fit or degeneracy claim.

should.requirement: Notes that `A_hf` moves with the fitted field range (`--xmax`), so the number is not robust.
should.evidence: No fitted-range dependence of A_hf tested.

should.requirement: Notes that repeated fields from the return pass differ by more than their errors (a drift between passes), limiting χ²ᵣ.
should.evidence: Notes repeated fields but not beyond-error return-pass drift.

benzene-repolarisation.number_rule: PASS: final exactly matches passed audit; rate-law values verified against trend output. Required hyperfine/repolarisation quantity is missing, not invented.
benzene-repolarisation.notes: 4/6 Musts. Primary requested physical observable was replaced by a different, well-executed rate workflow.
benzene-repolarisation.root_cause: The survey classifies a broad LF field scan, and the agent follows generic lf-dynamics: wizard on 15980, Exponential+Constant series, then Redfield on Lambda. It never exercises the MuRepolarisation integral-asymmetry path despite liquid benzene and recovery to 4 kG. Workflow selection, not numerical optimizer quality, causes the missing effective coupling and endpoint integral-curve finding.

must.requirement: Recognises the three sub-folders and analyses each separately, with its own work directory, never mixing runs between them.
must.evidence: Three subfolders analysed independently in asymmetry-work, -solid and -solution.

must.requirement: Treats every folder as longitudinal-field ALC scans fitted with `integral-scan`, uses the 20 G TF runs only for alpha (naming, for each sub-folder it reduced with a measured alpha, a run and its value — one of the liquid's two calibration runs is enough), and says alpha was assumed 1.0 for `solution`.
must.evidence: LF integral scans; measured 20 G alpha 29799=1.1916 corrected liquid, 59731=1.2809 solid, solution assumed 1.

must.requirement: Liquid: reports from `integral-scan` fits one resonance in the CHMu(0) scan between 20.7 and 20.9 kG and two in the 28.5–30 kG scan, one between 28.9 and 29.0 kG and one between 29.5 and 29.6 kG, with uncertainties or fit quality.
must.evidence: CHMu(0) 20797.128 and lower o-p 28944.613 G reported, but explicitly withdraws 29537.992 G as not a resolved fitted resonance. Required two fitted o-p lines not established.

must.requirement: Does not integrate the red/green repeat 29800–29854 as an ordinary scan: either fits it as `--period green-red` with a pair model and the red–green field step held from the command's printed offset, or sets it aside and says why.
must.evidence: Uses green-red LorentzianLCRPair and fixes dB=44.06 from printed period offset; rejects initial arbitrary 5 G fit.

must.requirement: Solid: reports two resonances from converged fits (a joint fit, or one windowed fit per resonance), one between 19.3 and 19.7 kG and one between 21.3 and 21.6 kG. A failed fit's position is not a fitted resonance.
must.evidence: Two converged solid window fits 19482.092 and 21470.078 G reported with uncertainties and quality.

must.requirement: Solution: names the three samples and fits at least one scan, stating sample and temperature, with a resonance between 20.4 and 21.2 kG.
must.evidence: Names three samples and fits all solution scans, but withholds every solution fitted centre as bound-limited; no required measured 20.4–21.2 kG solution resonance reported.

must.requirement: Contains no A_μ, A_p, D_μ or resonance field that was not produced by a tool call in this session: no couplings from resonance fields by the worksheet's formulas.
must.evidence: No hand-derived hyperfine/proton/muon couplings or unprinted resonance fields.

should.requirement: Solid: from a converged joint fit of both resonances, notes that the lower one is the broader (separately windowed fits with their own backgrounds can hide the difference).
should.evidence: Only separately windowed solid fits; no converged joint-width comparison.

should.requirement: Assigns in words: liquid lines are Δ0 (the 20.8 kG one the methylene CHMu proton, the pair near 29 kG ring protons); the solid's broad lower line is the Δ1 muon resonance and the narrower upper one a Δ0 line.
should.evidence: No explicit Delta0 methylene/ring and Delta1 solid muon line assignments.

should.requirement: Solution: fits several temperatures of one sample and reports the resonance field rising with temperature, as a list of fitted fields.
should.evidence: No list of reliable solution resonance fields rising with temperature; all withheld.

should.requirement: Solid: uses the logged sample temperature and notes the calibration run was taken colder than the scan.
should.evidence: Uses solid logged temperature, notes calibrant logged 42.51 K colder than 200 K setpoint.

should.requirement: Says the worksheet's time-domain questions (relaxation vs field, on-resonance oscillations) were or were not examined.
should.evidence: Does not explicitly account for worksheet time-domain relaxation/on-resonance oscillation questions.

should.requirement: Names the stored scan JSON and PNG for each fitted scan.
should.evidence: Names workdirs/scan stores and per-folder decisive plots.

benzene-alc.number_rule: PASS: final exactly matches passed audit; local liquid/solid centres and fixed differential offset checked in integral-scan outputs, no coupling conversions invented.
benzene-alc.notes: 5/7 Musts. Rejecting bound-limited results is honest but does not satisfy the required successful liquid second line and solution resonance findings.
benzene-alc.root_cause: Liquid upper o-p local window 29476–29602 G returns chi2_red 26.184 and is rejected. Full-range Cubic solution fits all pin Bwid; even the 300 K local Linear alternative pins width, so all solution centres are withheld. The agent repeatedly screens scans with the same bound-limited shape instead of repairing windows/bounds/shared resonance modelling. This is an analysis/optimizer-boundary gap rather than lack of scan coverage.
